semantics.identity_rule: Each approval decision has explicit evidence identity.
semantics.stale_rule: Material change to plan/target/risk invalidates prior approval as configured.
semantics.authority_rule: Approval is necessary evidence where required but execution still uses operational authorization.

invariants.rule: Release candidate, accepted release, deployment plan, deployment execution, installed artifact, active runtime instance and observed health remain separate identities/states.
Operational convenience, availability pressure, maintenance state, automation, recovery or rollback never silently bypass validation, authorization, integrity, governance or dispatcher boundaries.
